summary.text: Richard McGrew is a Republican state representative from Arkansas House District 85 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. McGrew owns McGrew Companies and previously served as a Garland County justice of the peace.

paragraphs.text: McGrew was born in Hot Springs, Arkansas.
His career experience includes owning McGrew Companies.
He has been affiliated with Rotary Club International, has served on the boards of Champion Christian College and the Salvation Army, and has served as a justice of the peace of Garland County.
McGrew assumed office in the Arkansas House on January 9, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session McGrew was assigned to the House Insurance and Commerce Committee, the House Revenue and Taxation Committee and the Joint Energy Committee.
